plugins.name: cua-toolkit
plugins.description: Autonomous desktop computer-use for AGNT, powered by the Cua Driver (trycua/cua). Lets agents see windows, read accessibility trees + screenshots, click elements by index, type text, and run a full autonomous goal loop — all in the background without stealing your cursor or focus. Self-contained: cua-setup action=ensure installs the driver + starts the daemon in one call.
plugins.author: Annie (AGNT)

schema.title: Cua Setup & Doctor
schema.description: Install, verify, and manage the Cua Driver. ensure=ONE-CALL bootstrap (install if missing + start daemon + doctor). Other actions: status, doctor, install, serve, stop, version.

schema.title: Cua List Windows
schema.description: Read-only. Enumerate open desktop windows the driver can see, returning each window's pid, windowId, title, and app.

schema.title: Cua Observe Window
schema.description: Read-only. Capture a window's accessibility tree (every interactive element with its index) plus an inline screenshot. Feeds the autonomous loop.

schema.title: Cua Input (Click / Type / Hotkey)
schema.description: Low-level primitive input on a real window: click by element index, type text, press hotkeys, launch apps. Background dispatch — does not steal cursor/focus. Requires confirm=true.

schema.title: Cua Autonomous Act
schema.description: High-level autonomous loop. Give a natural-language goal and a target window; tool observes and returns a structured plan for the agent to drive the observe/reason/act/verify loop. dryRun by default; requires confirm=true to execute.

plugins.name: sentinel
plugins.description: Drop a URL, local path, or git repo and get a comprehensive, evidence-backed security report with exact file:line:CWE findings and concrete fixes. Real scanners find the bugs (semgrep, detect-secrets, dependency audits, web recon); the LLM only explains and prioritizes — it can never invent a finding.
plugins.author: AGNT

schema.title: Sentinel Scan
schema.description: Ingest a target (git URL, local directory path, or live http(s) URL) and run every applicable security scanner. Returns normalized, deduplicated, evidence-backed findings with file:line:CWE. Does NOT call an LLM — this is the deterministic ground-truth stage.

schema.title: Sentinel Report
schema.description: Turn Sentinel findings into a comprehensive, plain-English security report (HTML + Markdown) with an executive summary, per-finding impact and concrete fix. The LLM works ONLY from verified findings — it never invents vulnerabilities.

schema.title: Sentinel Audit (Scan + Report)
schema.description: One-shot: scan a target AND generate the full report. This is the node the simple frontend calls. Drop a URL/path/repo, get findings + an HTML report file back.
